project.title: Environmental Microorganisms in Strong-flavor Baijiu
project.description: The aim of this project is to characterise the bacterial and fungal communities present in the air and in fermentation-related materials within the production workshops of strong-aroma baijiu in Luzhou, Sichuan Province, China. Air samples were collected across the four seasons: spring, summer, autumn and winter. Bacterial 16S rRNA gene and fungal ITS amplicon libraries were constructed from each physical sample.
